description: [provider] Check which domains are covered before enriching (free). Check available companies in Ocean's database and trigger process of data gathering for the missing ones (Ocean.io · Company data) (costs $0.001 per call, paid automatically: from your wallet via x402 or from prepaid credits (API key))

inputSchema.description: FREE, and the right first call before a big enrichment run: it returns `successfulDomains`, so you learn which domains are covered without paying to enrich them, and the misses start being crawled in the background. Re-run the enrich a while later for the ones that were missing

domains.description: domains to check and, if missing, queue for collection

name: oceanio_companies_warmup
